title: AIVV Multi-Model Synthesized Finding
description: Schema for a synthesized finding after multi-model dispatch Stage 7 (attribution restore). Standalone — does not extend finding.json via $ref because finding.json carries additionalProperties:false which blocks draft-07 allOf extension. The confidence field here means cross-provider agreement confidence, overriding the per-reviewer HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW meaning.

likelihood.description: Scalar will-it-manifest probability (reachability × exposure × trigger-conditionality), mirrored from finding.json. Distinct from confidence (is-it-real). Optional; consumed by the impact×likelihood severity model (`severity_model: impact_likelihood`), absent under the default `legacy_4pass`. Per-provider likelihood maps are out of scope here.

impact_tier.description: Scalar magnitude-of-harm-if-triggered tier, mirrored from finding.json, anchored to observable harm categories never reviewer tone. Optional; pairs with `likelihood` in the impact×likelihood model's 4×4 cell-map, absent under the default `legacy_4pass`. Per-provider impact maps are out of scope here.

confidence.description: Cross-provider agreement confidence. verified: ≥2 different-provider reviewers agree. moderate: ≥2 reviewers agree (same-provider acceptable). single-reviewer: only one reviewer found this finding — preserved with explicit label, not discarded.

value.description: Optional improvement-track prominence metadata, mirrored from finding.json. Used only for POLISH sorting/prominence; never a defect severity tier.

effort.description: Optional improvement-track cost metadata, mirrored from finding.json. Used with value for Quick-Win prominence; never a defect severity tier.

source_type.description: Citation source category. `websearch` / `webfetch` for URLs surfaced via WebSearch / WebFetch. `context7` for library identifiers from Context7 MCP (form: `<library-id>@<version>`). `runtime` for orchestrator-captured runtime artifacts such as axe-core output, computed-style contrast records, screenshots, or screenshot diffs. `internal-repo` for repo-relative paths used as evidence (verify by Grep, not external source). `unverified` when no external grounding was applied. `unverifiable` when the claim was attempted-but-failed to ground (no authoritative source located). The `unverifiable` value is preserved for parity with skills/methodology/SKILL.md emission contract.

source_ref.description: URL, library identifier (`<id>@<version>` for context7), or repo-relative path (for internal-repo). For `unverified` / `unverifiable`, a one-line label describing what was not grounded.

excerpt.description: Optional short excerpt or quote from the source supporting the claim. Helps consumers verify the citation without re-fetching.

mm_confidence.description: The per-reviewer confidence range from the highest-confidence individual reviewer, preserved for reference.

severity_reported.description: Severity as reported by each reviewer-id before max-aggregation.

reviewer_attribution.description: Model IDs of reviewers who independently found this issue.

agreement_count.$comment: MUST equal reviewer_attribution.length — not enforceable in draft-07 but maintained by orchestrator invariant. Included as a convenience field for consumers that prefer not to compute array length.
agreement_count.description: Number of reviewers who found this issue.

agreement_diversity.description: Whether agreeing reviewers are from different providers.

single_reviewer.description: True when only one reviewer found this finding.

truncated_coverage.description: True when the diff was truncated and this finding may reflect incomplete coverage.

allOf.$comment: confidence=verified requires single_reviewer=false (verified requires ≥2 different-provider reviewers; AC-8)
